topics.name: #REST Root
topics.purpose: Define `#REST` as the reserved root for named REST instance definitions and route bindings, preserving separation between service identity, listen binding and exposed canonical semantics.

semantics.owner_rule: #REST resolves to named REST instance/configuration semantics.
semantics.instance_rule: Each REST instance has stable logical identity separate from port/listen binding.
semantics.port_rule: No universal default REST port is implied.
semantics.route_rule: Routes bind to explicit canonical operations/resources/views.
semantics.runtime_rule: Declared instance, enabled state and running listener state remain separate.
semantics.authority_rule: Route existence/network reachability does not grant operation/data authority.
semantics.semantic_rule: REST exposes semantics owned elsewhere and never becomes their semantic owner.

invariants.rule: Each reserved runtime root resolves to one explicit semantic owner/family; the root itself never creates semantic ownership or runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: REST instance identity defined by port
REST route becomes semantic owner of target
declared REST instance conflated with running listener

references.purpose: REST routes bind exactly to canonical targets.
